title: ze_penguin_of_doom
description:
A cold wind blows across the land. You sense the stirring of a sinister presence - something you have not felt for many years. It can only mean one thing - the penguin of doom has awakened. If not stopped he will plunge the world into an enternal winter.

A map for the "Return To Roots" contest. Basically a bunch of random ideas connected together whilst I tried to learn hammer. Thanks to the denizens of the Mapeadores discord #mapping channel for assistance. Thanks for Mapeadores and GFL for some testing.

Thanks for the various creators for models/textures used under the creative commons license. More info here
